name: Mind Blank

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: For 24 hours a willing creature is immune to Psychic damage and the Charmed condition and shielded from mind-reading and scrying.
text: The target can't have its emotions, thoughts or location sensed by magic, and no spell, even Wish, can spy on it or control its mind.
